name: Eiteag

attributes.attribute: a Scottish fairy who made her home in Glen Etive

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eiteag is a woman of Scottish myth. This fairy lived in the remote Glen Etive, a beautiful valley that took her name. She may be a late echo of a land goddess.

okr.objective: Present Eiteag as a fairy bound to the valley of Glen Etive.
key_results: Eiteag is a fairy of Scottish lore.
She makes her home in Glen Etive.
The name may hold a faint echo of a land goddess.
